_meta.source: CDS C9 (GPA distribution) + C21 (ED/EA) via LLM

schools.notes: C9 mapped from WPI Common Data Set 2024-25 GPA ranges. C21 early decision includes two ED rounds listed in the PDF: first/only ED plan (279 applied, 211 admitted) and other ED plan (1/5 close) with no applicant/admit counts reported; therefore only the reported ED counts were used. C22 early action counts reported as 9,020 applied and 6,214 admitted.

C11 GPA table present but all reported percentages are blank/0.00, so canonical GPA distribution cannot be derived and is represented as zeros from the source text. C21 early decision values reported; C22 early action plan exists but no applicant/admit counts are provided.

C9 high school GPA distribution reported as all enrolled degree-seeking first-time first-year students on a 4.0 scale; percentages mapped to canonical bands. C21 shows the institution offers Early Decision and Early Action, but the Fall 2024 counts for applications/admissions are blank in the provided text.

C11 used as the GPA distribution table; mapped 4.0 GPA to 3.75-4.00 and combined 2.50-2.99, 2.0-2.49, 1.0-1.99, and below 1.0 into <3.00. C21 reports no Early Decision and no Early Action breakdown values in the provided text.

C11 reported GPA distribution for all enrolled students only; mapped 4.0 GPA into 3.75-4.00 and combined all GPA below 3.00 into <3.00. C21 indicates no Early Decision and no Early Action plan, so counts are null.
C9 GPA distribution table not present in provided PDF text; C21 early decision and early action numeric fields not present in provided PDF text.
